result:
I've finished the DG5 round-3 review: my verdict is **PASS**, both of my round-2 findings are verified closed, and I raised two new Low findings. Those two findings are still OPEN, and the gate validator won't approve DG5 until every finding is closed, repaired or accepted. So the gate still needs one more step after this review: either a small test-only fix (my recommendation, as with F-DG5-141/144) or both findings accepted as observations by a specialist and the release-auditor.

I reviewed candidate `sha256:d8d83181…` (2203 files, source `54e02b6`) on a complete disposable clone. Its ID matched at the start and the end, and only two test files changed since round 2. I formed my verdict without reading the other reviewers' round-3 records.

**Round-2 findings, both verified closed:**
- **F-DG5-143 (Medium):** the auditor test now passes in English and Arabic in both locale settings. I added two mutants that show the auditor an "approve date" or a "move" button; both make the test fail at the new matcher, in both languages. A static check of the screens' labels found no write button that the new matcher misses and the old one caught.
- **F-DG5-144 (Low):** raid test 5 took 24.6 s in Arabic during the full suite, at load up to 16.8, against its new 90 s budget. All 14 tests in that file ran and passed.

**New findings (Low, not mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer):**
- **F-DG5-145:** `p4-benefits.spec.ts` test 8 still runs on the default 30 s budget. It took about 25.8 s even on its own and timed out at 30.2 s in the full suite (English). No assertion failed; the steps simply add up.
- **F-DG5-146:** the `session-end.spec.ts` test "signed out in another tab" races the My Work page, which is still loading work items page by page. The logout landed between two pages, so the app correctly ended the session before the test clicked its link. This is its first recorded failure.

**Results:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | 7/7 |
| Unit tests (Node 22 and 24, both locale settings), within the agreed load limit | 4/4: 2350 / 1746 / 259 + 2 skipped by design |
| Integration, run twice on a fresh database | 3084 passed + 1 skipped by design each time; 846 operations, migrations to 0097, pending lists empty |
| `tests/qa` alone | 336/336 (A06 27, A07 12, A15 34, A16 30) |
| Root acceptance specs | 30/30 in both locale settings |
| Demo stack | 18/18 and 8/8 in both locale settings |
| Read-only auditor sweep of 34 P5 screens (390 px, 200 % text, accessibility checks) | 0 problems in English and Arabic |
| My REQ-PB-093, REQ-PB-090, REQ-S21-001, REQ-PB-087 and REQ-S13-008 probes; 82 export samples | All pass |
| Validators (register, pipeline, historical DG1–DG4) | 6/6 |

**Product end-to-end runs: neither was fully green, and every failure is explained:**
- **Locale unset:** 463 passed, 2 failed (the two new findings), 5 did not run because they follow a failed test. Both specs pass 28/28 when run alone.
- **C.UTF-8:** 469 passed, 1 failed. My own disk-space guard caused that one: it deleted a shared Playwright trace file the test needed. That spec passes 16/16 alone, and I limited the guard so it only prunes when disk is low.

I recorded that check as PASS with the failures and exit code disclosed, and judged the product behaviour verified.

One part is blocked by the environment: I couldn't render the PDF, DOCX, PPTX and XLSX samples to images, because LibreOffice needs a writable `/tmp` and no PDF library is installed. I inspected them at content level instead (Arabic right-to-left, fonts, labels), and the samples are kept in the evidence folder.

The disposable clone is removed. The automatic permission check refused my final cleanup of leftover test scratch folders under `$TMPDIR`; the runner deletes that directory when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-3/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

The run notes and logs are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-3/`, starting with `RUN-NOTES.md`.
